body:
Watch Out!
Okay, I have been high many times before.. Drunk a few times... but I promised myself that this is all I would do... EVER.  But when me and my friend went to her boyfriends house, he had a fry stick (a cigarette soaked in Embalming fluid...WHAT THEY PUT IN DEAD PEOPLE - and dried it)  We smoked his pot first, and when we were good and blazed, he gave us the cigarette.
We were too high to notice anything wrong... But I smoked most of it... 3/4's of it... then my friend asked for some.  She took like 3 or 4 drags off of it and asked her boyfriend what was in it.  He said nothing and took it away from her and took a tiny, almost fake drag off of it... and put it out and threw it away right away.  About 5 minutes later, my heart began to pound out of my chest and started racing.  I could not catch my breath, and my left arm from my elbow down went numb... I THOUGHT I WAS HAVING A HEART ATTACK!  My friend was experiencing the same thing, so we went away for a while to cool down a bit... and decided that we were going home.
This was 6 days ago, and I am still feeling the affects of that shit.  I am probably going to go to the doctor about it because its seriously bad.  If you don't believe me, do some research on it.  Just look up 'Embalming Fluid.'  Please at least be careful with this shit.  IT IS NO GOOD.  Stick with good old weed.  I am still having major problems because of this like major short term memory loss... panic attacks, depression, heart palpitations, and I am just plain acting stupid.. cant get the thoughts out of my head... But yeah, be CAREFUL!
